互联网泡沫顶前 9 个月

summary.verdict_desc:
**一句话**：市场广度指标 S5FI 9/11 收 38.76、首次跌破 40 红线，叠加 Fed 9 月加息定价一周内从六成飙到近九成，红灯升至 8 个（32.0%），估值与资金面共振把判读继续锁在高风险预警。

**广度**：本期最硬的新证据来自市场结构。S5FI 于 9/11 收 38.76（9/10 一度低见 33.39），首次跌破 40 的红线——对照上期 50%（估算）与 8/30 实测 54%。同一周指数层面几乎无恙（标普周内 -0.68%、周五收涨 0.96%），但等权标普跌幅接近市值加权的三倍、罗素小盘 -2.38%，是典型的「头部独自撑盘」。这也是 breadth_50d 自 8/23 误读被修正后，第一次由真实读数而非估算确认转红。

**政策与信用**：8 月 CPI 同比 3.4%、核心 2.4%，PPI 同向，CME FedWatch 对 9/16 加息的定价由上期 59-62% 跳到 85-90%，10 年美债 4.80% 创一年新高。但信用面完全没有跟上：HY OAS 270bps（9/10 观测）比上期 265 只多 5bps，离 350 黄线还有 80bps 的空间；数据中心 ABS 一级市场仍在正常出货（QTS $14.7 亿本周广泛分销），只是 BBB- 档预推销被拉长到两周、执行摩擦初现。加息定价与信用定价的这道裂口是接下来最值得盯的地方——历史上引线真正点燃时，两者会同向。

**反向证据**：基本面六项里五项是绿的，且本期都拿到新读数。OpenRouter 近 30 日 token 量 463.3T、环比 +70.1%（上期 411.0T/+60.4%），绝对量周环比 +12.7%；Oracle 9/10 的 Q1 FY27 把 RPO 推到 $6640 亿（同比 +$2090 亿、环比 +$260 亿），OCI 收入 +121%（上季 +93%），积压是在加速兑现而非拉长年限；GPT-6 Astra（9/3）把 FrontierMath T4 推到 97.6%、ARC-AGI-3 推到 62.7%，与 Claude Fable 5.1（9/1）、Gemini 3.8 Flash（9/2）三天内连发。这些是最难用「纯泡沫」解释的部分。

**判读**：基础档位按 red_pct 32.0% 只到中度警戒，但估值红灯 2 个（CAPE 41.09、前五权重 27.75%）叠加资金面红灯 3 个（Mag4 FCF、VC 占比 70%、NVDA 客户投资 43%——后者已连续 22 期红灯）触发**共振升级**，强制到高风险预警。两轴上泡沫成熟度 60.0（亢奋）持平，破裂临近度由 36.7 抬到 40.0（零星火花），距两轴升级所需的 50 还差 10 分。本周边际 2 恶化 / 1 好转、净 +1，未触及「边际恶化加速」的 +4 门槛。分母提醒：N 仍为 25，本期 red_pct 与前期口径一致，可直接比较。

**历史坐标**：与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）相似度 80%，仍是最像的时点；其次 1999-06 74%、2021-11 72%、2007-10 50%。与 2000-02 向量的主要差异集中在五项——龙头远期估值（NVDA 约 22x，绿 vs 红）、IPO 管道（Anthropic 10 月定档但 OpenAI 推 2027，黄 vs 红）、债务/capex 比（56%，黄 vs 红）、算力商品价格（H100 主力价稳，绿 vs 黄）、企业真实采用度（72% 在产，绿 vs 黄）。这五项里任意两项转色即为顶部前夜的确认信号；本周广度已先一步补齐了 2000-02 向量里的那个红。
summary.verdict_desc_en:
**Bottom line**: Market breadth broke down this week — the S5FI closed at 38.76 on Sep 11, its first print below the 40 red line — and September rate-hike pricing jumped from roughly 60% to nearly 90%, pushing the red count to 8 of 25 (32.0%) and keeping the verdict pinned at High Risk Alert.

**Breadth**: The hardest new evidence came from market structure. The share of S&P 500 members above their 50-day average closed at 38.76 on Sep 11, after touching 33.39 the day before, against 54% measured on Aug 30 and an estimated 50% last week. The index itself barely moved — the S&P was down 0.68% on the week and rallied 0.96% on Friday — but the equal-weight index fell nearly three times as hard as the cap-weighted one and small caps dropped 2.38%. That is the classic signature of a handful of names carrying the tape. It is also the first time since the mis-read of Aug 23 was corrected that this indicator has turned red on a real print rather than an estimate.

**Policy versus credit**: August CPI came in at 3.4% headline and 2.4% core, PPI pointed the same way, and CME FedWatch pricing for a hike at the Sep 16 meeting moved from 59-62% a week ago to 85-90%. The 10-year Treasury sits at 4.80%, a one-year high. Credit has not followed. High-yield OAS printed 270bps on Sep 10, up just five basis points from last week and still 80bps clear of the yellow threshold. Data center ABS is still clearing — QTS syndicated a $1.47bn deal this week — though a two-week pre-marketing stretch on its BBB- tranche is the first visible execution friction. The gap between what rates markets are pricing and what credit markets are pricing is the thing to watch: at genuine tops, the two move together.

**The other side of the ledger**: Five of six fundamentals are green, and all of them refreshed this week. OpenRouter logged 463.3 trillion tokens over the trailing 30 days, up 70.1% month over month from 411.0T and 12.7% week over week in absolute terms — no sign of demand fatigue anywhere in the series. Oracle's Sep 10 fiscal Q1 lifted remaining performance obligations to $664bn, up $209bn year over year and $26bn sequentially, with OCI revenue accelerating to +121% from +93%, meaning backlog is converting faster rather than being stretched out. And GPT-6 Astra, released Sep 3, took FrontierMath Tier-4 v2 to 97.6% and ARC-AGI-3 to 62.7%, arriving within seventy-two hours of Claude Fable 5.1 and Gemini 3.8 Flash. Frontier capability — the one trigger with no historical analogue in this framework — remains comfortably green.

**The call**: On red share alone, 32.0% would only warrant Moderate Caution. But two valuation reds (CAPE at 41.09, top-five weight at 27.75%) alongside three capital reds (Mag4 free cash flow, AI's 70% share of venture dollars, and Nvidia customer financing at 43% of revenue — red for twenty-two consecutive issues now) trigger the **cross-category resonance rule**, forcing the verdict up to High Risk Alert. On the two axes, bubble maturity holds at 60.0 (Euphoria) while proximity-to-rupture rose from 36.7 to 40.0 (Sparks), still ten points short of the 50 that would trigger the second upgrade path. Net momentum was +1, two deteriorations against one improvement, well inside the +4 acceleration threshold. Note on the denominator: N remains 25, so this week's red share is directly comparable with prior issues.

**Historical bearings**: The current colour vector matches February 2000 — one month before the dot-com peak — at 80%, ahead of June 1999 at 74%, November 2021 at 72% and October 2007 at 50%. Five indicators account for most of the remaining distance to that February 2000 vector: leader forward multiples (Nvidia near 22x, green then red), the IPO pipeline (Anthropic locked for October but OpenAI explicitly pushed to 2027, yellow then red), debt as a share of capex (56%, yellow versus above 70%), compute commodity pricing (H100 medians holding, green then yellow) and genuine enterprise adoption (72% in production, green then yellow). Any two of those five flipping would confirm entry into the pre-top window — and breadth has already supplied one of the reds that vector requires.

wow_changes.note_en: The S&P 500 share above its 50-day average closed at 38.76 on Sep 11 after touching 33.39, breaking the 40 red line for the first time on a measured print rather than an estimate.

wow_changes.note: Hiive 口径给 Anthropic 隐含 $8800 亿、较 $9650 亿 Series H 折价 8.8%，与 Caplight 的 $1.4 万亿溢价口径正面冲突；OpenAI 一级溢价收窄至约 2%，溢价扩大的格局结束。
wow_changes.note_en: Hiive now marks Anthropic at an implied $880bn, an 8.8% discount to its $965bn Series H, flatly contradicting Caplight's $1.4tn premium mark; OpenAI's premium to its last round has narrowed to about 2%.

wow_changes.note: 12 家 30 日公开市场卖出额由 $6.854 亿升至 $9.383 亿（+36.9%），NVDA 单家 $6.530 亿占七成；买盘仅 $29.6 万（全部来自 TSM）。
wow_changes.note_en: Thirty-day open-market insider selling across the twelve-name basket rose 36.9% to $938.3M, with Nvidia alone accounting for $653.0M, against just $0.3M of buying — all of it at TSMC.

wow_changes.note: OpenRouter 近 30 日 token 量 463.3T（上期 411.0T），绝对量周环比 +12.7%，环比增速连续第 4 期抬升。
wow_changes.note_en: OpenRouter's trailing-30-day token volume reached 463.3 trillion from 411.0T, a 12.7% weekly gain in absolute terms and a fourth straight acceleration in the month-over-month rate.

wow_changes.note: Oracle 9/10 交出季度 capex $280 亿、自由现金流 -$50 亿的财报，股价 9/11 仍涨 7%，并带动 CoreWeave/Nebius +4%——本期唯一的新事件是奖励而非惩罚。
wow_changes.note_en: Oracle posted $28bn of quarterly capex and negative $5bn free cash flow on Sep 10, and the stock still rose 7% the next day while CoreWeave and Nebius gained 4% in sympathy — the only fresh datapoint of the week was a reward, not a punishment.

indicators.note: multpl.com 主源连续多期 egress 受限后本期恢复：页面顶部读数 41.09（截至 9/11 收盘，日内 +0.36/+0.87%），较上期三源中值 40.8 回升。仍高于 35 红线约 17%，处 1881 年以来 98.8 分位，仅次于 1999-2000 峰值 44.19。
indicators.note_en: multpl.com came back online after weeks of blocked access, printing 41.09 as of the Sep 11 close, up from last week's 40.8 three-source median. That sits roughly 17% above the 35 red line and in the 98.8th percentile since 1881, behind only the 44.19 peak of 1999-2000.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >25 red / 18-25 yellow / <18 green
indicators.note: SSGA SPY 官方持仓（slickcharts 仍 403）：前五单类合计 27.75%（NVDA 8.08 / AAPL 7.33 / MSFT 5.59 / AMZN 3.77 / GOOGL 2.98），较上期 28.0% 回落 0.25pt，回落全部来自 NVDA 8.29→8.08；含 Alphabet 双类 30.14%，top10 38.15% 与上期持平。仍是 2000 年峰值约 18% 的 1.5 倍。
indicators.note_en: From SSGA's official SPY holdings file (slickcharts still returns 403), the top five single-class names total 27.75% — Nvidia 8.08, Apple 7.33, Microsoft 5.59, Amazon 3.77, Alphabet 2.98 — down 0.25pt from 28.0%, with the entire decline coming from Nvidia slipping to 8.08 from 8.29. Counting both Alphabet share classes the figure is 30.14%; the top ten held flat at 38.15%. Concentration remains about 1.5x the 18% peak of 2000.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >40 red / 30-40 yellow / <30 green
indicators.note: 唯一带 9 月新日期的读数为 StockAnalysis 18.12（9/11，股价 $218.29、TTM EPS $7.91、trailing PE 27.60），较上期同源 19.10 再降；FinanceCharts 25.64（8/28）、GuruFocus 24.50（8/19）为财报前后旧读数，取中枢约 22x。绝对水平仍远低于 1999 年 MSFT 的 60x——本轮龙头贵在市值不在倍数。
indicators.note_en: The only reading carrying a fresh September date is StockAnalysis at 18.12 on Sep 11, against a $218.29 share price, $7.91 of trailing EPS and a 27.60 trailing multiple — down from 19.10 at the same source last week. FinanceCharts (25.64, Aug 28) and GuruFocus (24.50, Aug 19) are pre- and post-earnings stragglers, leaving a centre of about 22x. That is still far below the 60x Microsoft carried in 1999: this cycle's leader is expensive by market cap, not by multiple.

indicators.threshold_text: 转折价（低于最近一轮 5%+）或标价明显下跌 红 / 溢价收窄且卖压>买压 黄 / 溢价稳定或扩大 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Marks below last round by 5%+ or clearly falling red / premium narrowing with sellers outweighing buyers yellow / premium stable or widening green
indicators.note: 本期两个平台正面冲突：Hiive 口径 9/13 给 Anthropic 每股 $1,039.92、隐含 $8800.1 亿，较 $9650 亿 Series H **折价 8.8%**；Caplight 口径则仍在 $1.2-1.4 万亿（溢价 24-45%），承销商按 2028 年营收讨论最高 $2 万亿的 10 月上市定价。OpenAI 侧 Forge 挂牌 $721.85（隐含约 $8943 亿）连续第 3 期逐位未动，Hiive $737.24、隐含 $8682.6 亿，较 $8520 亿一级仅溢价 1.9%——上期还是 5-7%。溢价扩大的格局结束，但单一平台折价与另一平台大幅溢价并存、成交极稀（Rainmaker 称「没人卖，很难成交」），不足以判红。降至黄灯，再有一个平台确认折价即触发红线。
indicators.note_en: Two platforms are now flatly at odds. Hiive marks Anthropic at $1,039.92 a share on Sep 13, implying $880.1bn — an 8.8% discount to the $965bn Series H. Caplight still has it between $1.2tn and $1.4tn, a 24-45% premium, while underwriters discuss an October listing as high as $2tn against 2028 revenue. On the OpenAI side, Forge has been frozen at $721.85 (about $894bn implied) for a third consecutive week, while Hiive's $737.24 implies $868.3bn — a premium to the $852bn primary of just 1.9%, down from 5-7% last week. The widening-premium regime is over, but a discount at one venue alongside a large premium at another, on almost no completed trades (Rainmaker: 'no one's selling, so it's rare to get a trade done'), is not enough for red. Downgraded to yellow; one more venue confirming a discount would trip the red line.

indicators.name_zh: 超大规模厂商资本开支同比
indicators.threshold_text: 下调指引 红 / 加速 黄 / 稳健 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut red / accelerating yellow / steady green
indicators.note: 本期新读点为 2027 口径再上修：Goldman 预测 2027 全行业 capex $1.01 万亿、较 2026E 的 $7650 亿 +32%；big4 2027 一致预期 $9345 亿（GOOGL 2848 / AMZN 2565 / MSFT 2076 / META 1856 亿）。2026 big4 $7250 亿、同比 +77%（2025 为 $4100 亿）。Oracle 9/10 维持 FY27 capex $900-950 亿指引、当季已花 $280 亿。仍是无一家下调、口径持续上修 —— 加速本身即黄。
indicators.note_en: The new datapoint this week is another upward revision to 2027. Goldman now models $1.01tn of industry capex next year, 32% above its $765bn 2026 estimate, while consensus for the big four sits at $934.5bn — Alphabet $284.8bn, Amazon $256.5bn, Microsoft $207.6bn, Meta $185.6bn. The 2026 big-four figure stands at $725bn, up 77% from $410bn in 2025. Oracle held its FY27 guidance at $90-95bn on Sep 10 after spending $28bn in the quarter. Nobody has cut, and every revision points up — acceleration alone keeps this yellow.

indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤-20 red / -20 to 0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: Q2 台账不变（META $7.84 亿 / AMZN TTM -$76 亿 / MSFT $196 亿 / GOOGL -$58.55 亿），下一读点为 10 月下旬 Q3。本期两条新硬数据：① Oracle 9/10 的 Q1 FY27 经营现金流创纪录 $230 亿，但 capex $280 亿把自由现金流压到 **-$50 亿**；② FactSet 测算五大 hyperscaler 的增量年度债务占 capex 比例已由 FY24 的 9% 升至 2026 年中 LTM 的 32%——自有燃料让位外部融资的过程已过三分之一线。
indicators.note_en: The Q2 ledger is unchanged — Meta $784M, Amazon negative $7.6bn on a trailing basis, Microsoft $19.6bn, Alphabet negative $5.855bn — with the next read due at Q3 results in late October. Two hard datapoints landed this week. Oracle's fiscal Q1 on Sep 10 produced record operating cash flow of $23bn, but $28bn of capex pushed free cash flow to negative $5bn. And FactSet calculates that incremental annual debt across the five hyperscalers has climbed from 9% of capex in FY24 to 32% on a trailing basis by mid-2026 — the shift from self-funding to external funding is now a third of the way through.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >50 red / 30-50 yellow / <30 green
indicators.note: 本期复核确认 Q3 完整占比仍未发布（PitchBook/Crunchbase 均待 10 月初），H1 2026 续为最新硬数据：全球 AI 占创投 70%、美国 86%（美国 H1 总额 $4127 亿中 AI $3559 亿），OpenAI + Anthropic 两家 $2170 亿即占全球全部创投的 43%。本期新增 Q2 单季交叉印证：Q2 全球创投中 AI 占比 >70%（此前台账只有 Q1 的 80-81%）。健康水位 <30%，当前是其 2.3 倍。
indicators.note_en: A fresh check confirms no complete Q3 split has been published — both PitchBook and Crunchbase are due in early October — so H1 2026 remains the latest hard reading: AI took 70% of global venture dollars and 86% in the US, where $355.9bn of $412.7bn went to AI. OpenAI and Anthropic alone absorbed $217bn, 43% of all global startup funding. New this week is a Q2-specific cross-check showing AI above 70% of global venture capital in that quarter, where the ledger previously only had Q1's 80-81%. A healthy baseline is under 30%; the current level is 2.3 times that.

indicators.name_zh: 英伟达客户投资占收入比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >30 red / 15-30 yellow / <15 green
indicators.note: **连续第 22 期红灯**（自 2026-05-17 首期起从未转色），分母 LTM 收入 $3050 亿不变。二阶变化本期继续偏收敛：CNBC 口径 2026 年内已投出的股权 $400 亿（其中 OpenAI $300 亿）中，约 $180 亿承诺尚未执行；私募持仓公允价值 7 月已达 $479 亿；黄仁勋明确表示对 OpenAI 再投 $1000 亿「不在考虑之列」、$300 亿那笔「可能是最后一次开支票」。俄亥俄背书上限仍锁定 $1050 亿（8/17 SEC 文件，由传闻的 $2500 亿下修）。承诺额停止扩张、但存量仍是 Lucent 1999 年 vendor financing 24% 的近一倍。
indicators.note_en: Red for a twenty-second consecutive issue — it has never changed colour since the series began on May 17, 2026 — on an unchanged $305bn trailing revenue denominator. The second derivative keeps converging. Of the $40bn of equity Nvidia has committed in 2026 (including $30bn to OpenAI), roughly $18bn remains unexecuted, while the private portfolio's fair value reached $47.9bn in July. Jensen Huang has now said a further $100bn into OpenAI is 'probably not in the cards' and that the $30bn cheque 'might be the last time' Nvidia writes one. The Ohio backstop stays capped at $105bn per the Aug 17 filing, down from the $250bn originally reported. Commitments have stopped growing, but the stock of them is still nearly double the 24% vendor-financing ratio that marked Lucent's endgame in 1999.

indicators.name_zh: 标普 50 日线上方比例
indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤40 red / 40-60 yellow / >60 green
indicators.note: **本期终于拿到实测值**：S5FI 9/11 收 38.76（前一交易日 33.39，日内 +5.37/+16.08%），eoddata 与 Investing.com 两源一致。对照 8/30 实测 54%、上期估算 50%，两周内退去约 15pt 并首次跌破 40 红线。同周结构证据同向：标普指数周内仅 -0.68%，等权标普却 -1.87%、罗素小盘 -2.38%、道指 -1.51%，等权跌幅接近市值加权三倍；Money Flow Breadth Ratio 70%（上期 75%、峰值 80%），MACD 维持看跌交叉，RSI 50.9。指数新高附近广度 <40% 是 2000-02 与 2021-11 都出现过的顶部形态。
indicators.note_en: A measured print at last: the S5FI closed at 38.76 on Sep 11, up 5.37 points from 33.39 the previous session, with eoddata and Investing.com agreeing. Against 54% measured on Aug 30 and an estimated 50% last week, roughly 15 points of breadth have drained away in a fortnight and the 40 red line has broken for the first time. The week's structure corroborates it: the S&P fell just 0.68% while the equal-weight index dropped 1.87%, small caps 2.38% and the Dow 1.51% — the equal-weight decline was nearly triple the cap-weighted one. The Money Flow Breadth Ratio slipped to 70% from 75% (peak 80%), MACD holds its bearish crossover and RSI sits at 50.9. Breadth below 40% near index highs is the pattern that showed up in both February 2000 and November 2021.

indicators.threshold_text_en: >20 red / 5-20 yellow / <5 green
indicators.note: SEC EDGAR Form 4 直聚 12 家、窗口 8/14-9/13、共 203 份：**卖出 $9.383 亿 / 买入 $29.6 万**，比值 3171x（买盘近零，比值对分母极敏感，value 取上限 99）。卖出额较上期 $6.854 亿 +36.9%，连续第 4 期抬升（$4.11→$4.70→$5.82→$6.85→$9.38 亿）。本期几乎全部由 NVDA 贡献：单家 $6.530 亿、占 70%（上期 $4.174 亿）；其次 PLTR $8967 万、MU $5277 万、AMD $4864 万、MSFT $4339 万。唯一买盘 $29.6 万全部来自 TSM。反向注脚：Larry Ellison 9/13 取消了原定 $75 亿的减持计划（ORCL 本窗口 Form 4 为零）。
indicators.note_en: Aggregated directly from SEC EDGAR Form 4 filings across the twelve-name basket for the Aug 14 to Sep 13 window, 203 filings in total: $938.3M sold against $295,867 bought, a ratio of 3,171x. With buying effectively zero the ratio is hypersensitive to its denominator, so the stored value is capped at 99. Selling rose 36.9% from $685.4M and has now increased for four straight periods, tracing $411M, $470M, $582M, $685M, $938M. Nvidia supplied almost all of the increase at $653.0M, 70% of the total and up from $417.4M, followed by Palantir at $89.7M, Micron $52.8M, AMD $48.6M and Microsoft $43.4M. The only purchases, $295,867 of them, came at TSMC. One counter-signal: Larry Ellison cancelled a planned $7.5bn share sale on Sep 13, and Oracle logged no Form 4 activity in this window at all.

indicators.value_display: 升温·临界 (Anthropic 定档 / OpenAI 推 2027)
indicators.value_display_en: Heating up, near threshold (Anthropic locked in, OpenAI pushed to 2027)
indicators.threshold_text: 洪流 10+ 红 / 升温 3-9 黄 / 平静 <3 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood of 10+ red / heating up 3-9 yellow / quiet under 3 green
indicators.note: 本期两条方向相反的新消息。收紧侧：Sam Altman 9/12 明确表示安全与对齐优先使 2026 年上市「不明智」，OpenAI 正式推到 2027，Polymarket 对「Anthropic 先上」的定价已到 93.8%。加热侧：Anthropic 招股书公开申报推迟至 9 月底、路演最早 10 月中、目标在 11 月中期选举前数日挂牌，承销团 GS/JPM/MS，讨论区间最高 $2 万亿；Oura 目标 9 月上市、拟募 $30 亿、估值 $160 亿+。未来 6 个月已宣告的 AI 相关发行仍在 7-9 家的上沿，尚未达到 10+ 的洪流阈值，但 Q4 被普遍称为「史上最集中的 AI 股权事件窗口」。
indicators.note_en: Two pieces of news pulling in opposite directions. On the cooling side, Sam Altman said on Sep 12 that safety and alignment priorities make a 2026 listing unwise, formally pushing OpenAI to 2027; Polymarket now prices Anthropic listing first at 93.8%. On the heating side, Anthropic's public prospectus filing has slipped to late September with a roadshow no earlier than mid-October and a listing targeted days before the November midterms, led by Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley at a valuation discussed as high as $2tn; Oura is targeting a September listing raising up to $3bn at more than $16bn. Announced AI-related offerings over the coming six months remain at the top of the seven-to-nine band, short of the ten that would mean a flood — though Q4 is now widely described as the most concentrated window of AI equity issuance on record.

indicators.name_zh: 高收益债期权调整利差
indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2 = 270bps（9/10 观测），较上期 265 走阔 5bps；近五个观测日 270/271/267/268/268，方向微幅走阔但幅度可忽略。本期的关键不是水平而是背离：同期 10 年美债 4.80% 创一年新高、9 月加息定价 85-90%，信用面却仍距 350 黄线 80bps。FRED 有一日发布时滞，9/11 CPI 后的反应要下期才入序列。
indicators.note_en: FRED's BAMLH0A0HYM2 printed 270bps on Sep 10, five wider than last week's 265, with the last five observations at 270, 271, 267, 268 and 268 — drifting wider but by an amount that barely registers. The point this week is not the level but the divergence: the 10-year Treasury hit a one-year high of 4.80% and September hike odds reached 85-90%, yet credit sits 80bps clear of the yellow threshold. FRED publishes with a one-day lag, so the reaction to the Sep 11 CPI print will only enter the series next week.

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.value_display: 分层：一级仍在发·执行拉长
indicators.value_display_en: Two-tier: primary still clearing, execution slower
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ 红 / 稳定 黄 / 收窄 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: 50bps+ wider red / stable yellow / tighter green
indicators.note: 本期新事件：QTS（Blackstone 旗下）$14.7 亿数据中心证券化于 9 月第二周广泛分销，标的为已进入稳定现金流的资产——一级市场没有关门。但执行细节转差：其中 $2.8 亿 Fitch/S&P 双 BBB- 档提前约两周向小范围投资人预推销、就 5/7/10 年三档定价征求反馈，GlobalCapital 直言这种超长预热「不寻常」。公司债侧同向：AMZN/GOOGL/META/ORCL 的 2-4 年期中位利差已由 2025 年 30bps 升至 40bps，JPMorgan 口径六家 hyperscaler 美元债利差 50→80bps。2026 年 DC ABS 发行已破 $100 亿，JPMorgan 预计全年 $300-400 亿。整体仍是「量在、价稳、摩擦初现」的分层格局，未达 50bps+ 走阔。
indicators.note_en: The week's event was QTS, Blackstone's data center platform, syndicating a $1.47bn securitisation of stabilised assets in the second week of September — the primary market has not closed. Execution detail is where it got harder: a $280M tranche rated BBB- by both Fitch and S&P was pre-marketed to a small group roughly two weeks in advance, seeking price feedback across five, seven and ten-year tenors, a warm-up GlobalCapital called unusual. Corporate credit points the same way, with median two-to-four-year spreads for Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Oracle at 40bps versus 30bps in 2025 and JPMorgan putting the six hyperscalers' dollar-bond spreads at 50 to 80bps. Data center ABS issuance has passed $10bn in 2026 with JPMorgan forecasting $30-40bn for the year. Volume is there and pricing is stable, but friction is showing — short of the 50bps of widening that would turn this red.

indicators.value_display: 观察 (0 起评级动作·利率压力升温)
indicators.value_display_en: Watch (no rating actions, rate pressure building)
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认事件 红 / Watch 评级 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed event red / on watch yellow / none green
indicators.note: 过去 90 天仍无评级下调、违约或压力交换的已确认事件——CoreWeave 的 $85 亿 GPU 抵押融资仍是 Moody's A3 / DBRS A(low)。但压力在两侧同时上升：① 利率端，10 年美债 4.80% 创一年新高、9 月加息定价近九成，而 CoreWeave 需持续回债市为 2030 年 8GW 目标融资；② 报表端，CoreWeave 总债务与租赁 $516 亿（含 $165 亿融资租赁）、债务权益比 8.94，Q2 利息支出 $6.40 亿已超过其 $0.49 亿经营亏损，利息增速 140% 对营收增速 112%。对照 Nebius：总债务与租赁 $100.6 亿、现金 $80.4 亿、Q2 经营现金流 $23 亿并预计 2026 年收到 >$90 亿客户预付，杠杆结构分化明显。7 月底 CDS 一度触及 855bps（隐含五年违约概率约 50%）的旧读数未再刷新。
indicators.note_en: No confirmed downgrade, default or distressed exchange in the trailing ninety days — CoreWeave's $8.5bn GPU-backed facility still carries Moody's A3 and DBRS A(low). Pressure is nonetheless building from two sides. On rates, the 10-year sits at a one-year high of 4.80% with September hike odds near 90%, while CoreWeave must keep returning to debt markets to fund its eight-gigawatt 2030 target. On the statements, CoreWeave carries $51.6bn of combined debt and leases including $16.5bn of capital leases, a debt-to-equity ratio of 8.94, and Q2 interest expense of $640M that now exceeds its $49M operating loss, with interest growing 140% against 112% revenue growth. Nebius looks materially different: $10.06bn of debt and leases against $8.04bn of cash, $2.3bn of Q2 operating cash flow and more than $9bn of customer prepayments expected in 2026. The late-July CDS spike to roughly 855bps, implying a 50% five-year default probability, has not been revisited.

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >70 red / 50-70 yellow / <50 green
indicators.note: 周度增量：本周新增 1 笔 deal —— QTS（Blackstone）$14.7 亿数据中心证券化，9 月第二周广泛分销；无单笔 ≥$100 亿。台账 YTD 累计由 $2003 亿升至 $2018 亿、共 17 笔。分子沿用 9/6 完整对账结果：中心 $6000 亿、区间 $5700-6500 亿（MS 全口径锚 $5700 亿为下沿，Goldman 口径 AI 相关债务 YTD 约 $5000 亿）；分母 2026E 全口径 AI 基建 capex $1.08 万亿 → 比值 55.6%，取 56%。本期新增交叉印证：Goldman 预计五大 hyperscaler 2026 年发债约 $2500 亿、2027 年 $4000 亿；AMZN/GOOGL/META/ORCL 截至 7/7 已发 $1940 亿（同比 +79%）。距 70% 红线仍有 14pt，下次完整对账 10/4 之后。
indicators.note_en: Weekly increment: one new deal, QTS's $1.47bn data center securitisation broadly syndicated in the second week of September, with nothing at or above $10bn. The ledger's year-to-date total rises from $200.3bn to $201.8bn across seventeen deals. The numerator carries over from the Sep 6 full reconciliation at a $600bn centre within a $570-650bn range, with Morgan Stanley's all-in $570bn anchor at the low end and Goldman putting AI-related issuance at roughly $500bn year to date. Against a $1.08tn all-in 2026 AI infrastructure capex denominator that gives 55.6%, rounded to 56%. New corroboration this week: Goldman expects the five hyperscalers to issue about $250bn of bonds in 2026 and $400bn in 2027, and Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Oracle had already issued $194bn through July 7, up 79% year over year. Still fourteen points below the 70% red line; the next full reconciliation falls after Oct 4.

indicators.name_zh: 行业 Token 量月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contracting red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: OpenRouter 官方 datasets API：近 30 日 463.3T tokens、前 30 日 272.3T，环比 **+70.1%**（数据截至 9/12，全平台 top50+other 口径）。绝对量较上期 411.0T 周环比 +12.7%；环比增速连续第 4 期抬升（+25.9%→+32.1%→+50.0%→+60.4%→+70.1%）。日度尾段 9/6-9/12 分别为 14.3/19.1/19.0/17.9/19.2/17.8/17.1T，工作日稳定在 17-19T 平台。需求侧是本期最干净的绿灯，没有任何减速迹象。
indicators.note_en: From OpenRouter's official datasets API: 463.3 trillion tokens over the trailing thirty days against 272.3 trillion in the prior thirty, a 70.1% month-over-month gain through Sep 12 on the full-platform top-50-plus-other basis. In absolute terms that is 12.7% above last week's 411.0T, and the month-over-month rate has now accelerated for four consecutive periods, tracing 25.9%, 32.1%, 50.0%, 60.4% and 70.1%. Daily volumes from Sep 6 to Sep 12 ran 14.3, 19.1, 19.0, 17.9, 19.2, 17.8 and 17.1 trillion, with weekdays holding a 17-19T plateau. Demand is the cleanest green in the panel, with no deceleration anywhere in the series.

indicators.value_display_en: Stable, no decline at the core tier
indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌 >15% 或普遍过剩 红 / 温和阴跌·空置上升 黄 / 稳定或紧俏 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Down 15%+ or broad oversupply red / mild drift lower with rising vacancy yellow / stable or tight green
indicators.note: Thunder Compute 9 月市场报告（9/1 复核）：H100 80GB 区间 $2.89-11.06/hr，neocloud 中位 $4.17、hyperscaler 中位 $7.89；H200 区间 $3.44-10.60，neocloud 中位 $4.50、hyperscaler 中位 $10.44。IntuitionLabs 同期给 15+ 家 $1.49-6.98 的更宽区间、Vast.ai 最低档 $1.38-1.49。**口径提示**：本期 neocloud 中位 $4.17 与台账上期的 cohort 中位 $3.32/$3.38 篮子构成不同，不可直接算环比；可比的是区间下沿与主力档，两者均与上期重叠、无 >15% 跌幅，H200 对 H100 仍维持溢价。算力商品价格是本体系里唯一直接看供需成交价的指标，目前没有 2000 年暗光纤式的塌陷迹象。
indicators.note_en: Thunder Compute's September market report, last reviewed Sep 1, puts H100 80GB at $2.89-11.06 an hour with a neocloud median of $4.17 and a hyperscaler median of $7.89, and H200 at $3.44-10.60 with medians of $4.50 and $10.44. IntuitionLabs shows a wider $1.49-6.98 band across fifteen-plus providers over the same period, with Vast.ai's floor at $1.38-1.49. A caveat on comparability: this week's $4.17 neocloud median comes from a different basket than the $3.32 and $3.38 cohort medians in the ledger, so no month-over-month can be computed directly. What is comparable — the bottom of the range and the core tier — overlaps last week's readings with no decline approaching 15%, and H200 still commands a premium over H100. This is the only indicator in the framework that reads compute supply and demand at the transaction price, and there is no sign yet of the dark-fibre-style collapse that preceded the 2000 telecom unwind.

indicators.value_display: 平稳·披露停滞第 6 期
indicators.value_display_en: Flat, sixth period without new disclosure
indicators.threshold_text: 减速 红 / 平稳 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decelerating red / flat yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: **连续第 6 期无新披露**：Anthropic 仍是 7 月底 $650 亿 run-rate（5 月 $470 亿、4 月 $300 亿，月增量由 $170 亿降至 $90 亿）、OpenAI 仍是 8 月 Brockman 内部信的 $400 亿。二阶导仍是「一加一减」：Anthropic 绝对增量在收敛、OpenAI 从春季 $250 亿平台重新起量。投资人预期 Anthropic 年底落在 $1000-1200 亿。**下期是关键读点**：Anthropic 招股书公开申报定于 9 月底，届时将首次出现经审计的收入数据，可一次性替换掉这个已停滞 6 期的锚。
indicators.note_en: A sixth consecutive period without fresh disclosure. Anthropic still stands at the $65bn run rate reported for end-July, against $47bn in May and $30bn in April, meaning monthly increments have fallen from $17bn to $9bn. OpenAI still stands at the $40bn Greg Brockman shared internally in August. The second derivative remains one-up-one-down: Anthropic's absolute increments are converging while OpenAI has re-accelerated off its $25bn spring plateau. Investors expect Anthropic to finish 2026 between $100bn and $120bn. Next week is the read that matters — Anthropic's public prospectus is due at the end of September and will produce audited revenue figures for the first time, replacing an anchor that has now been frozen for six periods.

indicators.threshold_text_en: ≤50 red / 50-65 yellow / >65 green
indicators.note: 季度调查无新整体读数，McKinsey Q1 2026 的 72%（2024 年 55%、2020 年 20%）续为主锚。本期新增两条独立交叉印证：Presenc AI 对全球 2000 强的口径给出 78% 已有至少一个 AI 工作负载进入生产（2024 Q1 为 41%），行业分化极大——科技软件 94%、金融 87%、专业服务 81%、电信 78%，而医疗 61%、制造 58%、零售 56%、能源 49%、政府 38%、教育 32%；NVIDIA 年度调查给出 64% 的组织在运营中实际使用 AI。「部署广、价值捕获窄」的裂口仍在：仅 37% 报告 EBIT 层面正贡献、31% 有 agent 进生产。
indicators.note_en: No new headline survey this quarter, so McKinsey's 72% from Q1 2026 remains the anchor, against 55% in 2024 and 20% in 2020. Two independent cross-checks landed this week. Presenc AI's Global 2000 sample puts 78% with at least one AI workload in production, up from 41% in Q1 2024, with an enormous industry spread — technology and software at 94%, financial services 87%, professional services 81%, telecoms 78%, against healthcare 61%, manufacturing 58%, retail 56%, energy 49%, government 38% and education 32%. Nvidia's annual survey has 64% of organisations actively using AI in operations. The gap between broad deployment and narrow value capture persists: only 37% report a positive EBIT contribution and 31% have agents in production.

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长 红 / 减速 黄 / 加速 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative red / decelerating yellow / accelerating green
indicators.note: 本期拿到本季最重要的硬读数：Oracle 9/10 盘后的 Q1 FY27，RPO 升至 **$6640 亿**（同比 +$2090 亿即 +46%、环比 +$260 亿，超预期的 $6399 亿），当季新签 AI 云合同 >$300 亿；更关键的是转化端——OCI 收入同比 **+121%**（上季 +93%），GPU 利用率 97.9%、季内新部署 30 万+ 颗，积压是在加速兑现而非靠拉长年限堆出。公司称新合同绝大多数为预付或客户自带硬件，不需 Oracle 追加资本。其余三家仍为 Q2 台账：MSFT RPO $6780 亿（+84% YoY、久期 2.3 年）、AWS $4960 亿、Google backlog $5140 亿，四家合计约 $2.3 万亿。
indicators.note_en: The quarter's most important hard reading arrived this week. Oracle's fiscal Q1, released after the close on Sep 10, lifted remaining performance obligations to $664bn — up $209bn or 46% year over year and $26bn sequentially, against a $639.9bn consensus — with more than $30bn of new AI cloud contracts booked in the quarter. The conversion side matters more: OCI revenue grew 121% against 93% last quarter, GPU utilisation hit 97.9% and over 300,000 GPUs were deployed in the period, meaning the backlog is being realised faster rather than stretched. Oracle said the vast majority of new contracts are prepaid or bring-your-own-hardware and require no incremental capital from it. The other three carry over from Q2: Microsoft at $678bn of RPO, up 84% with 2.3-year duration, AWS at $496bn and Google's backlog at $514bn, for roughly $2.3tn across the four.

indicators.value_display: 加速·三家 72 小时内连发
indicators.value_display_en: Accelerating, three frontier releases in 72 hours
indicators.threshold_text: 连续两季无实质提升 红 / 提升有限·倍增拉长 黄 / 90 天内困难基准实质刷新 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Two quarters without material gains red / limited gains with lengthening doubling time yellow / a hard benchmark materially refreshed within 90 days green
indicators.note: ① 困难基准（对比台账上期）：ARC-AGI-3 SOTA 仍为 GPT-6 Astra 62.7%（BenchLM 9/10 榜），90 天前台账为 GPT-5.6 Sol 7.8%——8 倍位移；FrontierMath Tier-4 v2 仍为 Astra 97.6%（90 天前台账 35.4%），Claude Fable 5.1 与 Fable 5 同题 87.8%。本期新读点是 HLE（带工具）：Claude Fable 5.1 以 **65.0%** 接手 SOTA，Opus 5 63.6%、Astra 57.2%（台账上期 SOTA 为 Opus 5 的 64.7%）——首次出现「新旗舰在 HLE 上不占优」的分化，但绝对水位仍在推高。② 发布密度：Claude Fable 5.1（9/1）、Gemini 3.8 Flash（9/2）、GPT-6 Astra（9/3）三天内连发，Astra 为 OpenAI 史上最大训练（Stargate 得州站 10 万+ GPU），并首次由旧模型监督新模型训练；ExploitBench 满分 100%。③ METR：TH1.1 已被顶尖 agent 基本饱和（>8 小时任务仅剩个位数未解、时长超两个 FTE 工作日），2024 年起倍增时间约 89 天（3 个月），远快于 2019-2025 全期的 188 天；TH2.0 尚未发布，下期继续跟踪。三层证据一致指向加速，本轮独有的这条 trigger 未点燃。
indicators.note_en: On hard benchmarks measured against the ledger: ARC-AGI-3 still tops out at GPT-6 Astra's 62.7% per BenchLM's Sep 10 board, against GPT-5.6 Sol's 7.8% ninety days ago — an eightfold displacement — and FrontierMath Tier-4 v2 stays at Astra's 97.6% versus 35.4% in the ledger ninety days back, with Claude Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 both at 87.8%. The new reading this week is Humanity's Last Exam with tools, where Claude Fable 5.1 takes the state of the art at 65.0% ahead of Opus 5 at 63.6% and Astra at 57.2%, against a prior ledger SOTA of 64.7%. That is the first time a new flagship has failed to lead on HLE, though the absolute level keeps rising. On release density, Claude Fable 5.1 on Sep 1, Gemini 3.8 Flash on Sep 2 and GPT-6 Astra on Sep 3 landed within seventy-two hours; Astra was OpenAI's largest training run ever, across more than 100,000 GPUs at the Stargate Texas site, and the first where earlier models supervised the new one, scoring a perfect 100% on ExploitBench. On METR, Time Horizon 1.1 is essentially saturated by the strongest agents — only a handful of tasks beyond eight hours remain unsolved and measured horizons exceed two full-time-equivalent days — with doubling time from 2024 onward at roughly 89 days against 188 days across 2019-2025. Time Horizon 2.0 has not yet published. All three layers point the same way: this cycle's unique trigger has not been lit.

indicators.name_zh: 会计造假/循环交易事件
indicators.threshold_text: 已确认 红 / 调查中 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Confirmed red / under investigation yellow / none green
indicators.note: 本期复核确认：仍无针对 AI 龙头的已确认会计造假认定或 SEC 执法立案，计数 0。三类背景压力续存但均未升格为调查——① Michael Burry 的折旧质疑：指 hyperscaler 按 5-6 年折旧 Nvidia 硬件而真实经济寿命约 2-3 年，估 2026-28 年少提折旧、多报利润约 $1760 亿，点名 Meta 与 Oracle 利润最多虚高 27%；相关公司均以利用率与故障率数据向审计师抗辩并持续通过。② SEC 检查部已把 AI 列为 2026 年常设检查优先项，重点核查发行人对自身 AI 能力表述的准确性；首席会计师办公室 6 月点出第三方服务商与数据质量控制两项关切。③ Supermicro 仍是唯一实体案例（E&Y 审计中途辞任），非本期新事件。
indicators.note_en: A fresh check confirms zero: there is still no confirmed accounting finding or SEC enforcement action against a major AI name. Three sources of background pressure persist without escalating into investigations. Michael Burry continues to argue that hyperscalers depreciate Nvidia hardware over five to six years when its real economic life is closer to two or three, estimating $176bn of understated depreciation and overstated profit across 2026-28 and singling out Meta and Oracle as overstating earnings by as much as 27%; the companies defend their schedules to auditors with utilisation and failure data and keep passing. The SEC's Division of Examinations has made AI a standing 2026 priority focused on the accuracy of issuers' claims about their own AI capabilities, and the Office of the Chief Accountant flagged third-party service providers and data-quality controls in June. Supermicro, where Ernst & Young resigned mid-audit, remains the only concrete case and is not new this period.

indicators.threshold_text: 隐含加息 红 / 维持高利率 黄 / 隐含降息 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike priced in red / on hold at high rates yellow / cut priced in green
indicators.note: 本期是加息定价的加速确认。CME FedWatch 对 9/16 加息 25bp 的概率 9/12 已达 **85.5%**，盘中一度按 CPI/PPI 后的报价升至近 90%，上期区间为 59-62%、8 月下旬为 31.6%——三周内翻近三倍。触发点是 8 月通胀：CPI 环比 +0.4%、同比 3.4%，核心环比 +0.3%（超预期 0.1pt）、同比 2.4%。当前目标区间 3.50-3.75%，加息后为 3.75-4.00%。9/16 同时是 SEP 会议，点阵图与决议同日落地。跨资产同向：10 年美债 4.80% 创一年新高。
indicators.note_en: Rate-hike pricing accelerated sharply this week. CME FedWatch put the probability of a 25bp increase on Sep 16 at 85.5% on Sep 12 and quotes reached close to 90% intraday after the CPI and PPI prints, against 59-62% last week and 31.6% in late August — nearly a tripling in three weeks. August inflation was the trigger: headline CPI rose 0.4% on the month for 3.4% annually, while core rose 0.3%, a tenth above forecast, for 2.4%. The target range stands at 3.50-3.75% and would move to 3.75-4.00%. Sep 16 is also a Summary of Economic Projections meeting, so the dot plot lands with the decision. Cross-asset confirmation: the 10-year Treasury is at 4.80%, a one-year high.

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚 红 / 偶发惩罚 黄 / 奖励 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment red / occasional punishment yellow / rewarded green
indicators.note: 本期唯一的新事件是清晰的奖励。Oracle 9/10 盘后交出季度 capex $280 亿、自由现金流 -$50 亿、并维持 FY27 $900-950 亿 capex 指引的财报，9/11 盘前涨 5.5%、盘中最高 +7% 至 $164.25（虽尾盘收窄部分涨幅），同时带动 CoreWeave 与 Nebius +4%——市场把 $6640 亿的积压当成对重资本开支的充分补偿。参照系仍未统一：8 月这轮里 Amazon 上调 2026 capex 至 $1800-1900 亿收涨 5%+，Meta 上调至 $1450 亿却因未说清变现路径重挫 10%。判为绿灯（奖励），但保留一句提醒：奖励的前提是订单可见度，讲不清转化的公司照样挨打。
indicators.note_en: The only fresh event this week was an unambiguous reward. Oracle reported after the close on Sep 10 with $28bn of quarterly capex, negative $5bn of free cash flow and unchanged FY27 guidance of $90-95bn — and the stock opened 5.5% higher on Sep 11 and traded up as much as 7% to $164.25, though it gave back part of that into the afternoon, dragging CoreWeave and Nebius 4% higher with it. The market treated a $664bn backlog as ample compensation for heavy spending. The broader picture is still not uniform: in the August round Amazon raised 2026 capex to $180-190bn and rose more than 5%, while Meta raised to $145bn without articulating how it converts to revenue and fell as much as 10%. Green on the reward, with the caveat that the reward is conditional on order visibility — companies that cannot show conversion still get punished.

indicators.value_display: 增加·Altman 以安全为由推迟上市
indicators.value_display_en: Increasing, Altman defers listing citing safety
indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热 红 / 部分对冲 黄 / 无 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Broad acknowledgement of overheating red / partial hedging yellow / none green
indicators.note: 存量表态未变：Altman 称投资者整体对 AI 过度兴奋、类比互联网泡沫，三人团队融数亿美元的估值「疯了」；Pichai 警告市场存在「非理性」、「没有公司能幸免，包括我们」；Nadella 称若增长只来自投资那就是泡沫，主张以全球生产率增速 10% 为真实标尺；Dimon 称自己「比多数人更担心」市场调整。本期新增两条方向相反的行为面证据：① Altman 9/12 以安全与对齐优先为由把 OpenAI 上市正式推到 2027——用推迟变现来对冲，是本期最实质的新对冲动作；② Larry Ellison 9/13 取消原定 $75 亿的减持，是反向信号。口头对冲广泛但仍非「普遍承认过热」的集体转向，维持黄灯。
indicators.note_en: The standing quotes are unchanged. Altman says investors as a whole are overexcited about AI, draws the dot-com parallel and calls valuations for three-person teams raising hundreds of millions 'insane'. Pichai warns of irrationality and that 'no company is going to be immune, including us'. Nadella argues that growth coming only from investment would itself be the bubble signal and proposes 10% global productivity growth as the real benchmark. Dimon says he is 'far more worried than others' about a correction. Two new behavioural datapoints cut in opposite directions this week: Altman formally pushed OpenAI's listing to 2027 on Sep 12, citing safety and alignment — hedging by deferring monetisation, and the most substantive new hedge of the period — while Larry Ellison cancelled a planned $7.5bn share sale on Sep 13, which points the other way. Verbal hedging is widespread but still short of a collective acknowledgement of overheating, so this stays yellow.
